title: Calibration Line on Denied-Operation Work and the Insurer's Supplement Decision — Insurance Claim Repairs Calibration Billing Note
content:
When operations an insurer denied are added to an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order at the customer's expense, the supplement read is the **most recently decided supplement** on the repair order — the supplement whose insurer decision is the latest recorded. When that supplement added sensor calibrations, the calibration line follows the insurer's decision on that supplement. The calibration price is the price of the tier of the ADAS Sensor Calibrations order opened for the repair order.

## Decision and calibration line

| Insurer's decision on that supplement | Calibration line |
|---|---|
| partially approved | the calibration price less the insurer's calibration allowance, never below zero, rounded to the cent |
| approved in full | no calibration line |
| any other decision | the full calibration price |

## The insurer's calibration allowance on a partial approval

- **Written hourly value** — the supplement's submitted amount less the calibration price, divided by the supplement's labor hours, rounded to the cent. A supplement with no labor hours has a written hourly value of zero.
- **Supplement labor the insurer kept** — the supplement's labor hours not on the consent (the supplement's labor hours less the labor hours written on the customer-pay addition consent) multiplied by the written hourly value.
- **Allowance** — the approved amount less the supplement labor the insurer kept.
- **Calibration line** — the calibration price less the allowance; where the allowance exceeds the calibration price, the line is zero.

## Worked lines (hypothetical figures: a calibration price of USD 400.00; a supplement submitted for USD 1,000.00 with 5.0 labor hours; a consent for 2.0 labor hours)

Written hourly value: USD 1,000.00 less USD 400.00 is USD 600.00, divided by 5.0 hours, USD 120.00. Labor kept: 5.0 hours less 2.0 hours is 3.0 hours, at USD 120.00, USD 360.00.

| Decision | Approved amount | Allowance | Calibration line |
|---|---|---|---|
| partially approved | USD 500.00 | USD 500.00 less USD 360.00, USD 140.00 | USD 400.00 less USD 140.00, USD 260.00 |
| partially approved | USD 900.00 | USD 540.00 | below zero, so USD 0.00 |
| approved in full | — | — | none |
| denied | USD 0.00 | — | USD 400.00 |
